summary: Frontend-only smoke test of Wave-4 i18n refactor. Logged in as Super-Admin and visited the 4 newly-translated authenticated routes (/tarjeta, /marketing, /marketing/inicio, /ajustes) plus the public Landing (/). For each route, toggled EN -> ES -> EN via [data-testid=lang-en|lang-es] and scanned document.body.innerText with a regex matching the 8 Wave-4 namespaces (landing, cardAdmin, socialStudio, marketingStart, profile, welcome, setupChecklist, tours). Zero raw i18n keys (e.g. 'cardAdmin.title') detected on ANY route in EITHER language. No runtime crashes, no console errors (only an unrelated Meta-pixel warning), no blank pages. Language toggle updates text live without reload and persists across navigation.

issues: Below the Wave-4 translated Profile section, the 'Suscripción / CORTESÍA / Acceso PRO de cortesía', 'Formas de pago' (Venmo/PayPal/Cash App/Zelle/Efectivo/Cheque descriptions), 'Guardar formas de pago', 'Cobra invoices con tu propia cuenta de Stripe', 'Stripe conectado y listo para cobrar', 'Ver mi panel de Stripe' blocks remain HARDCODED Spanish even when UI is in English. Not a Wave-4 regression (Wave 4 covered Your info / Business / About you / Save all / Log out which DO translate correctly), but flag for a future i18n wave.
'Traducir con IA' button next to the bio/role fields is also hardcoded Spanish in EN mode.

Greeting hero, 'PICK A TOPIC' / 'Digital Marketing · change', 'Not sure what to post — give me ideas ✨', and 'I know what to post, go to the studio →' translate correctly. The topic-chip LABELS themselves ('SEO local USA', 'Anuncios en Google', 'Gestión de redes', 'Campañas exitosas', 'Reseñas de clientes', 'Auditoría web gratis') remain in Spanish in EN mode because they are dynamic content served by the backend per industry (documented in iteration_30). This is by design, not a Wave-4 bug.

action_items: OPTIONAL future wave: translate the lower Settings sections (Suscripción / Formas de pago / Stripe Connect / 'Traducir con IA' button) so EN mode is fully English on /ajustes.
OPTIONAL: consider backend-side i18n for marketing topic chips so EN UI also shows English topic labels.
critical_code_review_comments: Wave-4 i18n implementation is clean: every page guarded by useTranslation, namespaces well-organized (landing/cardAdmin/socialStudio/marketingStart/profile/welcome/setupChecklist/tours), en.json and es.json have identical key trees, LanguageToggle.js uses i18n.changeLanguage with browser-detector persistence in localStorage (i18nextLng).
LanguageToggle component is properly identified by data-testid='language-toggle' with child buttons data-testid='lang-en' / 'lang-es' — good testability.

Settings.js mixes translated and hardcoded-Spanish blocks. Recommend extracting the Subscription/Payments/Stripe sections into a single 'profile.subscription.*' and 'profile.payments.*' namespace to finish parity.
